about: Every live judge verdict behind the Oct 7 section of eval/judge/RESULTS.md: the Oct 6 prompt and thresholds, with every tier pinned to named zero-retention hosts at fp8 or better, and the primary and fallback at temperature 0. run: pipeline (all tiers), primary or fallback alone. routing: each model's provider.only, provider.quantizations and temperature (null: none sent). Each verdict is [pair id, relation, confidence, explicit_change, tier that answered, outcome at the shipped thresholds (Contradicts 0.6), ms for the whole verdict]. No memory text or rationales; the pairs are in pairs.json and holdout.json.
